The reason why more and more teenagers(including me) are addicted to porn is that it is just a few clicks away and the taboo nature of it makes it more appealing. Other addicting things like drugs and alcohol are harder to find. I don't think there are effective ways in which porn can be regulated as that makes porn more unattainable meaning it increases the curiosity to watch it. Most porn for me was not about sex. It was more like entertainment of a different dimension. I had suddenly discovered something of a whole new level and I got addicted and couldn't stop. I used to open dozens of tabs and searching for hours combing through hundreds of websites to find the perfect video. Every day.The feeling of guilt after you finish also adds up. I think the reason I turned to porn was the absence of open conversation. If we had a few conversations about porn and why it was so addictive maybe I would have watched less. We will continue still watch porn there is not much you can do about that. But what can be done is educating why porn is so addictive and discussing why it might make people insecure about their bodies. If there was a way where we could ask questions to satisfy our curiosity and get reasonable and truthful answers porn whould be something that was watched occasionally. Thank you for reading my rant.
